title: Couple Outside Bungalow House, 1910s Snapshot B&W Photo
description: A black and white snapshot from around the 1910s depicting an older couple outside their shingle-sided bungalow house. The man, wearing a hat and suspenders, stands on the concrete walkway with hands on his hips, while the woman stands on the porch steps wearing a full dress with a white apron. Trees and a low wire fence line the front yard.
